thread.title: European Commission clears Apple acquisition of Shazam - MarketWatch

author: Emily Bary
title: European Commission clears Apple acquisition of Shazam - MarketWatch
text:
The European Commission said in a release Thursday that it had cleared Apple Inc.'s AAPL, -1.72% planned acquisition of Shazam, following an investigation that looked into whether the data housed by a combined Apple-Shazam would restrict competition in the streaming-music industry. "After thoroughly analysing Shazam's user and music data, we found that their acquisition by Apple would not reduce competition in the digital music streaming market," Commissioner Margrethe Vestager said in a statement. Apple has been looking to bolster its various media offerings in music, video, and news. The stock is up 0.3% in premarket trading Thursday and up 40% over the past 12 months. The Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, -0.16% has gained 19% in that time.
